description: Change of use from Office (B1) to Dental Surgery (D1)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, DG_PH_010_10, and DG_PH_011_19 received: 11/04/2019. Design and Access Statement received: 30/05/2019. DG_PH_018_19 received: 10/06/2019. Letter dated 15th April 2019 from Vokins Chartered Surveyors received: 03/07/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The building shall be used for D1 (Dental Surgery) use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting the order) no change of use of the D1 unit shall be carried out.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for D1 (Dental Surgery) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 08:00 to 19:00 hours on Mondays to Fridays, and 10:00 to 17:00 on Saturdays, Sundays and Public and Bank Holidays.
